description: Send crypto out of a Safe — the main account, a vault or a joint account — to a Moneda contact or a raw Base address, for any token the account holds. Not for selling a token (use initiate_crypto_trade), buying one (initiate_token_buy) or sending money (initiate_payment). Amounts are in the token's own smallest unit (atoms): call list_sendable_crypto first and use its `decimals` and `address`. Creates a request the user reviews, approves and signs in the Moneda mobile app — nothing moves until they do. After calling, poll get_payment_status.

amount.description: How much to send, in the token's smallest unit (atoms), e.g. '500000000000000000' for 0.5 of an 18-decimal token

recipientAccountId.description: Moneda contact / account UUID to send to

recipientAddress.description: Raw Base address to send to, for an external send

subAccountId.description: Vault or joint account to send FROM. Omit for the main Safe.

tokenAddress.description: Base ERC-20 contract address of the token to send

name: initiate_crypto_send
